import json, random, os
rng = random.Random(7)
plan = json.load(open('/workspace/tmp/t/work/maxplan.json'))['probes']
out = open('/workspace/tmp/t/work/maxlog.jsonl','w')
n = 300000
pad = ' '
for i in range(n):
    p = plan[rng.randrange(len(plan))]
    row = {"probe_id":p['id'],"received_ms":p['sent_ms'],"target":p['target'],"source":p['target'],"type":129,"code":0}
    s = json.dumps(row, separators=(',',':'))
    out.write(s + '\n')
out.close()
print(os.path.getsize('/workspace/tmp/t/work/maxlog.jsonl'))
EOF
